interviewChallenges.question: Why are standard relational B-Tree indexes suboptimal for high-volume time-series inserts?
interviewChallenges.idealAnswerKey: B-Tree indexes cause frequent page splits and cache invalidations as data grows. Partitioning by time chunk keeps active working sets in RAM.

interviewChallenges.question: What is the difference between a Liveness Probe and a Readiness Probe in container orchestrators?
interviewChallenges.idealAnswerKey: Liveness determines if the container needs a restart; Readiness determines if the container can currently accept incoming traffic.
